knownIssues.observed: One WebKit full-suite run restored the chat document after undo, but its detail remained in a pending mount state and the input was absent after 10 seconds. No wrong draft value was observed.
knownIssues.investigation: Original trace retained locally. A diagnostic repeat command announced 15 cases but only four completion lines were captured; not counted as 15 passes. A single 20-cycle delete/undo case passed with diagnostics, then passed again without diagnostics. The strengthened 20-cycle case subsequently passed in Chromium and Firefox, and the complete WebKit rerun passed 30 cases with 2 expected skips.
knownIssues.change: Strengthened the regression to 20 delete/undo cycles and an explicit zero-chat-request assertion. No speculative product fix or timeout relaxation.
knownIssues.remaining: Confirm cause of the intermittent pending mount. Passing reruns alone do not prove resolution.

knownIssues.observed: Formal capture-off dense-clock safe has 101 long tasks across the three full 330-frame windows; observe has 9. Safe reduces end-of-round detail roots to 65/64/76 but does not establish stable frame-time improvement.
knownIssues.remaining: Profile mount scheduling, clock updates and main-thread/GPU rendering separately; shared-host noise prevents causal attribution. Reference PC p95 acceptance remains open.
